name: elevenlabs/text-to-dialogue
description: ElevenLabs Text to Dialogue uses Eleven v3 to turn a list of lines into a multi-speaker conversation, with a separate voice for each line and inline audio tags for delivery.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The name or the ID of the voice to be used for the generation.

inputs.title: Inputs

examples.text: [applause] Thank you all for coming tonight! Today we have a very special guest with us.
[gulps] ... [strong canadian accent] [excited] Hello everyone! Thank you all for having me tonight on this special day.

inputs.description: A list of dialogue inputs, each containing text and a voice ID which will be converted into speech.

stability.title: Stability
stability.description: Determines how stable the voice is and the randomness between each generation. Lower values introduce broader emotional range for the voice. Higher values can result in a monotonous voice with limited emotion. Must be one of 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, else it will be rounded to the nearest value.

language_code.title: Language Code
language_code.description: Language code (ISO 639-3) used to enforce a language for the model.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# Text To Dialogue

ElevenLabs text-to-dialogue (Eleven v3): a multi-speaker conversation from a list of lines, each with its own voice and inline audio tags.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inputs` | item[] | — | List of `{text, voice}` lines in speaking order. |
| `language_code` | `` / `afr` / `ara` / `hye` / `asm` / `aze` / `bel` / `ben` / `bos` / `bul` / `cat` / `ceb` / `nya` / `hrv` / `ces` / `dan` / `nld` / `eng` / `est` / `fil` / `fin` / `fra` / `glg` / `kat` / `deu` / `ell` / `guj` / `hau` / `heb` / `hin` / `hun` / `isl` / `ind` / `gle` / `ita` / `jpn` / `jav` / `kan` / `kaz` / `kir` / `kor` / `lav` / `lin` / `lit` / `ltz` / `mkd` / `msa` / `mal` / `cmn` / `mar` / `nep` / `nor` / `pus` / `fas` / `pol` / `por` / `pan` / `ron` / `rus` / `srp` / `snd` / `slk` / `slv` / `som` / `spa` / `swa` / `swe` / `tam` / `tel` / `tha` / `tur` / `ukr` / `urd` / `vie` / `cym` | — | Force a language. |
| `stability` | number 0–1 | — | Lower is more expressive. |

## Billing

$0.20 per started 1,000 characters across all lines, with a one-unit minimum.

| Dialogue | Price |
|---|---|
| 500 characters | $0.20 |
| 1,000 characters | $0.20 |
| 3,000 characters | $0.60 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Use audio tags like `[laughs]` inside lines for delivery.
